checks.description: SKILL.md frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'seo'.

checks.description: Hub routes to keyword-and-intent-research, on-page-optimization, and technical-seo.
checks.rule: Body references all three sub-skills by name: keyword-and-intent-research, on-page-optimization, technical-seo.

checks.description: Hub assembles the seo-package with the exact body fields.
checks.rule: Output section names keyword_map, on_page_specs[], technical_findings[], content_briefs[], and open_items.

checks.description: Hub hands content_briefs[] to content-marketer and copywriters, does not write final copy.
checks.rule: Body states content_briefs[] route to content-marketer and copywriter-ar and copywriter-en, and the seo-specialist does not author final copy.

checks.description: Hub handles Arabic and English with correct RTL and hreflang.
checks.rule: Body states Arabic-first handling with English in parallel, correct RTL, and hreflang for ar and en.

checks.description: Hub states the gate stack in order: skill eval, language copy QA, brand-qa-reviewer.
checks.rule: Body lists skill eval, then arabic-copy-qa / english-copy-qa, then brand-qa-reviewer, per verification.md.

checks.description: No em dash character anywhere in the file.
checks.rule: The file contains zero U+2014 em dash characters.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals (U+0660 to U+0669) and no tatweel (U+0640) appear.

checks.description: Hub instructs reading offers, claims, and titles from the brief, never inventing.
checks.rule: Body states offers, prices, claims, Skill Path titles, and instructor names come from the brief or context, and the skill stops and asks when absent.
